note: EPT Core is the base/toolkit for the Extra Paragraph Types family. It provides the ept_settings field type (widgets ept_settings_default / ept_settings_simple, formatter ept_settings_default), the shared paragraph field storages field_ept_settings/field_ept_text/field_ept_title, the GenerateCSS/GenerateJS services that render per-paragraph design options, and global settings in config ept_core.settings (colors, *_breakpoint, *_width) edited at /admin/config/content/ept-core. No permissions of its own (form uses administer site configuration); no Drush (the starterkit submodule adds ept:module). Medium cases seed known ept_core.settings values (background color, mobile breakpoint) to read back; hard cases change the background color and desktop breakpoint, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal 'Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Core' module provide, and what is the machine id of the design-options field type it defines for paragraphs?
evals.expected_output: It is the base toolkit for EPT paragraph modules: it defines the ept_settings field type (default widget ept_settings_default, simple widget ept_settings_simple, formatter ept_settings_default) plus shared paragraph fields field_ept_settings/field_ept_text/field_ept_title and the GenerateCSS/GenerateJS services. It adds no usable paragraph type by itself.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the global EPT colors, responsive breakpoints and container widths, and in which config object are they stored?
evals.expected_output: On the settings form at /admin/config/content/ept-core (route ept_core.settings); values are stored in config object ept_core.settings (e.g. ept_core_background_color, ept_core_mobile_breakpoint, ept_core_default_width).

evals.prompt: How does EPT Core turn a paragraph's design options (margins, background, etc.) into actual styling on the page? Name the services involved.
evals.expected_output: The ept_core.generate_css (GenerateCSS::generateFromSettings) and ept_core.generate_js (GenerateJS::generateFromSettings) services convert the field_ept_settings design options into scoped per-paragraph CSS/JS, wired in through EptCoreHooks (preprocess_paragraph etc.).

evals.prompt: What is the global EPT background color currently configured on this Drupal site? Inspect the live configuration and give the HEX value.
What is the EPT mobile breakpoint currently set to on this Drupal site? Inspect the live configuration and give the pixel value.
On this Drupal site, set the EPT Core global background color to #ff0000 and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: config ept_core.settings ept_core_background_color is set to #ff0000, e.g. drush cset ept_core.settings ept_core_background_color '#ff0000', or the Background Color field on /admin/config/content/ept-core.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change the EPT Core desktop breakpoint to 1440 pixels and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: config ept_core.settings ept_core_desktop_breakpoint is set to 1440, e.g. drush cset ept_core.settings ept_core_desktop_breakpoint 1440, or the Desktop breakpoint field on /admin/config/content/ept-core.
